name: zer0-pages
description: Obsidian vault published as a Jekyll knowledge site via build-time bridge plugins; the second brain of zer0-mistakes.

paragraphs: Obsidian vault published as a Jekyll knowledge site via build-time bridge plugins; the second brain of zer0-mistakes.

zer0-pages is an AI-powered knowledge site with a twist: the content is an Obsidian vault, the librarian is claude-obsidian, and the publisher is Jekyll running in GitHub Actions. You (or Claude, on your behalf) write plain Obsidian-native markdown — wikilinks, callouts, Dataview queries — and a set of custom build-time "bridge" plugins convert those constructs to HTML for GitHub Pages. The site's look and feel comes from the zer0-mistakes theme, consumed as the published jekyll-theme-zer0 gem.
The vault is never polluted with Liquid templating. The published site never requires Obsidian. One body of content, two first-class consumers.
features: Content is a plain Obsidian vault with wikilinks, callouts and Dataview queries
Build-time bridge plugins convert Obsidian constructs to HTML for GitHub Pages
Styled by the zer0-mistakes theme, consumed as the jekyll-theme-zer0 gem
claude-obsidian acts as the vault's librarian
A graph view of how notes connect
